### Cyber Range: Defense Comparison

| Defense | Attack success after defense | Availability during attack (mean / min) | Legitimate traffic blocked | Recovery after defense (s) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Block source | 0.0% | 99.8% / 96.4% | 0.0% | 2.6 |
| Rate limit | 19.7% | 99.6% / 95.9% | 0.0% | 3.7 |
| Isolate target | 0.0% | 10.9% / 0.0% | 27.4% | 52.4 |
| Monitor only | — | 89.7% / 84.7% | 0.0% | — |
| Increase inspection | 100.0% | 89.7% / 84.7% | 0.0% | 47.4 |

_Mean over 9 scenarios, 10 seeds each, automatic response. Means hide that most scenarios are cheap for the server; with monitoring only, availability during the attack averaged 66% (DOS; worst second 37%) and 41% (DDOS; worst second 25%). Availability is modelled (capacity / load), not measured on a real service; isolation is lifted 5 s after the attack stops, so its recovery time reflects scenario length. '—' = not applicable._

Sources: `results/cyber_range/experiments/latest.json:suites.defense`

The zero-day scenario redraws the same 47 never-seen flows, so its runs are not independent zero-days._
